generated_for: User #1 Opportunity Source Universe expansion lanes
purpose: Define a broader source-universe acquisition plan so User #1 scholarship search does not depend on a tiny hand-picked candidate pie.
rules: The source universe must expand before the product promises three application-ready scholarships.
A source lane is not an eligibility claim; it is a structured acquisition target.
Aggregator leads expand search surface but cannot prove current applicant eligibility.
Official or sponsor sources remain required before applicant-facing claims.
Strict eligibility gating remains downstream from source expansion and may still return APPLICATION_READY: 0.
Do not store private FAFSA forms, exact income, SSNs, tax records, or full personal statements in the public repository.

lanes.name: Legal / paralegal professional bodies
lanes.purpose: Find professional-development, certification-support, student, and continuing-education sources aligned with User #1's legal office path.
applicant_fit_signals: Legal Assistant to Paralegal to Office Manager
acquisition_queries: Florida paralegal association scholarship professional development
paralegal certification scholarship professional development application
paralegal association student scholarship legal studies Florida
paralegal professional development grant certification fee scholarship
lanes.next_harvest_action: Build a Florida and national paralegal-association source queue before claiming application readiness.
guardrails: Do not infer membership eligibility.
Do not treat certification information as funding.
Membership-required sources must remain NEEDS_VERIFICATION until evidence exists.
notes: This is the strongest current User #1 lane but the seed set is too small.
